data.one_liner: Handle app icon badges for iOS, macOS, and Android
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin to set, get, increment, decrement, and remove app icon badges on iOS, macOS, and supported Android devices. It provides an imperative API for interacting with native badge counts.
use_when: You need to display unread message counts or alerts on your app icon on iOS and macOS.
You want to manage badge numbers using simple asynchronous Dart methods.
avoid_when: Your target audience primarily uses stock Android or Xiaomi devices where arbitrary numeric badges are not supported by the OS.
You require complex notification rendering beyond simple app icon badge updates.
strengths: Supports iOS, macOS, and several Android launchers.
Provides simple utility methods like increment and decrement for badge management.
Supports Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods on Apple platforms.
weaknesses: Android support depends heavily on the device manufacturer's launcher and has many unsupported environments (like Pixel stock Android and Xiaomi).
Requires platform-specific permissions and manual manifest/Info.plist configuration.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding notification permissions for iOS and specific broadcast/provider permissions in AndroidManifest.xml depending on target launcher requirements.
